notes:
I found one real program that fits: Parent & Tot at Halton Hills Gymnastics Centre. It's on the club's own pages. I left out the club's pre-school drop-in because I couldn't confirm it runs this fall.

```json
{
  "picks": [
    {
      "name": "Parent & Tot, Halton Hills Gymnastics Centre",
      "age_fit": "18 months - 3.11 yrs",
      "when": "Fall 2026 session Sept 12 - Dec 18, 30 minute classes",
      "source_name": "Halton Hills Gymnastics Centre"
    }
  ]
}
```

- **What it is:** 
The class involves parent participation and is led by a coach through a structured warm-up, games, music, and circuits on all gymnastic events.

- **Where:** 
36 Armstrong Avenue, Georgetown, 905-877-4330.

- **Registration:** 
Registration for the fall session opened July 20th.
 
It is first come, first served.

- **Schedule:** The club posts a Fall 2026 schedule PDF with several Parent & Tot time slots. The PDF's table came through scrambled, so I couldn't tie a particular day and time to a class. I left `when` at the session dates rather than guess.
- **Price:** No price appeared on the pages I read, so I left it out. The club also charges 
a $55.00 administration fee once per year.


The pre-school drop-in is listed at 
$15 for one parent and up to 4 children
 on 
Tuesdays and Thursdays, 9:30 am to 12:00 pm
. But the page's season dates look like last year's. One page gives 
October 9 till June 26, 2026
, with a March closure that matches the 2026 break. That's why I didn't list it.

I didn't find a Town of Halton Hills recreation toddler gymnastics class. My third search returned results for other places named Georgetown and Acton, and I didn't use any of them.
